extName.description: Extension name in Chrome and the Web Store. Max 75 characters. Keep 'Stash'.

extDescription.message: Snip posts from X, import all your bookmarks, and save pages, selections and images to the Stash app on your Mac.

cmdSavePage.message: Save the page or selected text to Stash

cmdScreenshot.message: Screenshot the visible part of the page to Stash

forMac.description: Popup header, after the bold word 'Stash'. Keep the leading space.

connecting.description: Popup status while it checks the app.

connection.description: Tooltip of the green or red status dot.

savePageHint.description: Popup button subtitle: what gets saved.

screenshotHint.description: Popup button subtitle: the app finds screenshots by their content.

importBookmarks.description: Popup button. X is the social network; keep 'X'.

importBookmarksHint.message: Scrolls through and saves them all

openStash.description: Button that opens the Mac app.

appPort.description: Label of the number field for the local network port.

portHint.description: Hint under the port field. Use the app's translated menu names.

statusConnected.description: Popup status. COUNT is a number of saved items. SEARCH is the search mode name.

keywordSearch.description: Search mode name shown in the popup status, lower case.

appNotRunning.description: Popup status when the Mac app is closed.

openAppHint.message: Open the Stash app on your Mac. Saves made now are queued and sent when it starts.
openAppHint.description: Popup message when the app is closed.

alreadyUpdated.description: Confirmation when the item was saved before.

savedForLater.message: Stash isn't running — saved for later
savedForLater.description: The app is closed; the save waits in a queue.

noResponse.description: Error: the extension did not answer.

reloadToReconnect.message: Reload the page to reconnect Stash.
reloadToReconnect.description: Error after the extension was updated.

saveToStash.description: Tooltip of the button on each X post.

savedClickRemove.message: Saved in Stash — click to remove
savedClickRemove.description: Tooltip of the button on a saved X post.

savedPost.description: Toast after saving an X post.

savedPostBy.description: Toast after saving an X post. HANDLE is the X user name.

cannotReach.description: Error: the extension cannot talk to the Mac app.

bookmarkSaved.description: Toast after the user bookmarks a post on X.

importOffline.message: Stash isn't running. Open the app, then try again.

importDoneNew.description: Bookmark import result with the number of new ones.

importFailed.message: $ERROR$. $COUNT$ bookmarks were saved before it stopped.
importFailed.description: Bookmark import error. ERROR is the reason.

importTitle.description: Title of the import panel on X.

importIncrementalHint.message: Save bookmarks added since the last import. Stash stops when it reaches posts it already has.

importFullHint.message: Save every bookmark to Stash on your Mac, with full text and images, ready for semantic search.

importProgress.description: Import progress, shown right after a bold number of saved bookmarks.

close.description: Accessible name of the close button.

appOffline.message: Stash isn't running. Open the Stash app on your Mac, or download it at stash.grasco.dev.
appOffline.description: Error when the Mac app is closed. Keep the domain.

appAnswered.description: Error with an HTTP status code.

selectTextFirst.message: Select some text on the page first.

importRedditSaved.description: Popup button: imports the user's saved posts and comments from Reddit. Keep 'Reddit'.

importRedditSavedHint.message: Saved posts and comments from your account

importBoard.description: Popup button, shown on Pinterest: imports the pins of the open board.

importBoardHint.message: Scrolls the Pinterest board and saves every pin

openPinterestBoard.description: Error when the board import starts on a page that is not a Pinterest board.

redditLoginFirst.message: Log in to Reddit first, then try again.
redditLoginFirst.description: Error when the Reddit import cannot find a logged-in Reddit account.

importingCount.description: Toast that updates during a Reddit or Pinterest import. COUNT is a number.

importSavedDone.description: Toast when a Reddit or Pinterest import ends.

importStopped.description: Toast when a Reddit or Pinterest import fails. ERROR is the reason.

importBrowserBookmarks.description: Popup button: imports all bookmarks of this browser into Stash and keeps new ones in sync.

importBrowserBookmarksHint.message: Saves all of them, then every new one
